rows: Amplitude Modulation; audio varies carrier amplitude; 540-1700 kHz (US MF band); simple detection, noise-susceptible
Frequency Modulation; audio varies carrier frequency; 88-108 MHz (VHF); amplitude-noise immune, wider bandwidth
LF/MF propagation along Earth's surface; hundreds to thousands km range; AM stations' primary mode
HF propagation reflecting off ionosphere; thousands of km range; variable, day/night dependent
VHF/UHF line-of-sight; limited to horizon; FM, TV use this; requires tall towers for range
FM bandwidth ≈ 2(Δf + f_max); FM broadcast: ±75 kHz deviation, 15 kHz audio = 200 kHz BW
Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing; many QAM subcarriers in one channel; WiFi, 5G, DVB use this
FM: stronger of two co-channel signals wins completely; AM: both are heard simultaneously
